subject.title: Unpack a packed hold to Not shipped

question: Should the public reservation status remain backward-compatible as `active`, or should Inventory make the `not_shipped` rename an explicitly versioned breaking SDK migration?
rationale: The repository identifies reservation records as public compatibility surface, while the PR changes both stored and exported status values without a compatibility period.

options.title: Preserve public compatibility
options.body: Keep the existing `active` SDK status and present “Not shipped” as display terminology until a versioned migration is approved.

options.title: Approve a breaking migration
options.body: Adopt `not_shipped` only with an explicit versioning, deprecation, upgrade-documentation, and consumer-proof plan.

recommendation.title: Preserve public compatibility
recommendation.body: Keep the existing `active` SDK status and present “Not shipped” as display terminology until a versioned migration is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository policy assigns merge approval to Bobby, making Bobby the clearest available owner for this compatibility decision.
